scope: Local Windows dependency installation, isolated development server and browser startup verification

checks.name: Selected Node project-directory write and removal
Launcher parse, CheckOnly and already-running handling
Stop script followed by full start script
Captured browser error logs at verification

service.profile: official isolated-dev with default data location

resolvedStartupObstacles: Original Node executable returned EPERM on writes; another existing Node 24 runtime passed the same filesystem checks. Underlying original-runtime cause remains undetermined.
ZIP checkout lacked Git metadata required by dev-profile.mjs; local git init supplied it.
Ordinary-profile xAI session initialization rewrote .env.local, triggering repeated Vite restarts. Official isolated profile avoids that watched settings path.
Custom data-directory setting was not retained because wrapper settings-read path and runtime settings-write path differ in this source version.
remainingLimitations: Windows startup reports a non-blocking warmup-path error for /@fs/src/main.tsx; the actual entry and browser editor load successfully.
AI calls, neural music models, actual media editing/export, MCP and HyperFrames integration were not tested.
